entities.name: River Kingdom
entities.description: A small nation of selkies in the Borderlands, on an island southwest of Almaaz.

entities.name: Borderlands
entities.description: Region cut off from Almaaz after the Flooding of Terisiare.

entities.name: Sarrazan River
entities.description: River in whose valley the selkies thrive.

entities.name: Silver Sea
entities.description: Inland sea created when the sea levels sank.

entities.name: Drufalen
entities.description: An ice sorceress who locked the Borderlands' water into an icy realm.

entities.name: Ogwater Rifkin
entities.description: Songmage who melted Drufalen's glacier and freed the Beast of the Hours.

entities.name: Beast of the Hours
entities.description: Creature imprisoned until Ogwater freed it, then banished.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Event that cut off the Borderlands.

entities.name: Chimes
entities.description: Valley of elves, destroyed by Ogwater.

events.summary: Drufalen cast a spell to lock the Borderlands' water into an icy realm, shrinking the Sarrazan River.
events.quote: cast a spell that would lock the water of the Borderlands into an icy realm

events.summary: In 3050 AR Ogwater Rifkin released the ice's hold through song magic, melting the glacier.
events.quote: released the hold of the ice on her realm through song magic

events.summary: Ogwater freed the Beast of the Hours, destroying the Chimes; the Beast was banished.

relations.note: her cold kingdom forced the selkies to roam for fish
relations.quote: forcing the selkies to roam further and further to find fish to eat
released the hold of the ice on her realm through song magic
